messages:
ada: FYI — customer reported big variance between preflight estimate and actual billing on an embeddings batch. preflight reported 900 units, runtime billed 1800 and split payload into 3 parts. filing a ticket but want a short design sync here.

josh: do we know why runtime chose 3 parts? was it quota, slotting, or quantization path?

maya: runtime saw mixed dims and an alignment padding that pushed several items over the small-batch fastpath -> forced split into 3. preflight was assuming no padding.

ryan: two axes to fix: 1) make preflight conservative and match runtime decisions; 2) surface both estimates so users see best/worst. I'm leaning to (2) to avoid giving everyone the highest number.

ada: product note: showing two numbers might confuse customers on invoices. prefer conservative on billing page, optimistic on "request inspector" flyout.

josh: console idea: show "Estimate: 900 (best) / 1800 (worst)" with a small help tooltip that explains why. add a CTA "Apply suggested split" that replays the request client-side with splitter applied.

maya: SDKs: offer a header `X-RW-Embed-AutoSplit: accept=true|false`. default false. also return `X-RW-Embed-Est: low=900;high=1800;plan=3` so SDKs can surface warnings.

ryan: telemetry: emit `embed.estimate_delta` metric (high - low) and `embed.split_reason` tag (padding|quant|quota). add alert when >1% of calls have delta>2x.

ada: UX for billing pages: always show conservative. for debug pages show both. link to support if split_reason=quant and delta>1000.

josh: rollout plan: stage header change in preflight service canary 5% for two days, gather `estimate_mismatch` rates, then flip console UI. deploy-bot can schedule.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: preflight-v3 canary 5% at 2026-03-25T22:00Z.

maya: I'll implement heuristic alignment (padding + quant decision) in preflight. it's a cheap compute but will add ~6ms median latency.

ryan: acceptable tradeoff for better predictability. also add a sampling recorder of raw inputs (0.05%) to debug future mismatches.

ada: please prod analytics for top 10 tenants by mismatches before changing billing UI. want to avoid churn.

josh: ok will pull that and action items: - maya: preflight heuristic commit + tests - ryan: telemetry + alerts - ada: console copy + CTA mock - josh: run tenant analysis.

maya: PR incoming today.

ada: thanks all. goal: fewer surprise invoices and clearer console guidance. :thumbsup:
